UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile and safety preferences for senior citizens and pensioners.

userId.description: The user UID matching the authenticated Google account.

displayName.description: The pensioner's display name or nickname.

emergencyContactName.description: Name of primary caregiver or family emergency contact.

emergencyContactPhone.description: Phone number of primary caregiver or emergency contact.

largeFontEnabled.description: Accessibility toggle for larger readable fonts.

autoTtsEnabled.description: Auto-read scam warnings aloud via text-to-speech.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of record creation. Clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of record update. Clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ScamCheckLog.title: ScamCheckLog
ScamCheckLog.description: Historical audit log of checked suspicious messages or phone numbers for caregiver review.

userId.description: The user UID who requested the scam check.

content.description: The suspicious message text or caller claim/number inspected.

explanation.description: Clear elderly-friendly explanation of why it was flagged.

flaggedPhrases.description: List of suspicious phrases detected in the input.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of inspection. Clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual user profile and safety configuration.

/users/{userId}/checkLogs/{logId}.description: Stores user scan and verification history.
